buildReceipt.scope: Input/artifact receipt after successful Gradle build; verify again before launch and after the study. Not a replacement for original outcome verification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; authors retain rights. Local evaluation and limited attributed screenshots; no raw archive redistribution.
dataset.source: VOT-LT2018 / Visual Object Tracking Challenge; https://www.votchallenge.net/vot2018/dataset.html ; original JPEGs, sampled source indices retained, nominal stride 1
dataset.title: Fresh139 ballet-100 public source

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.
input.annotator: VOT-LT2018 authors (rectangles/NaN); Codex source-only AI (visibility/cause/boundary uncertainty)

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; authors retain rights. Local evaluation and limited attributed screenshots; no raw archive redistribution.
dataset.source: VOT-LT2018 / Visual Object Tracking Challenge; https://www.votchallenge.net/vot2018/dataset.html ; original JPEGs, sampled source indices retained, nominal stride 1
dataset.title: Fresh139 ballet-100 public source

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.
input.annotator: VOT-LT2018 authors (rectangles/NaN); Codex source-only AI (visibility/cause/boundary uncertainty)

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

drift139.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.

drift139.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; authors retain rights. Local evaluation and limited attributed screenshots; no raw archive redistribution.
dataset.source: VOT-LT2018 / Visual Object Tracking Challenge; https://www.votchallenge.net/vot2018/dataset.html ; original JPEGs, sampled source indices retained, nominal stride 1
dataset.title: Fresh139 bicycle-98 public source

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.
input.annotator: VOT-LT2018 authors (rectangles/NaN); Codex source-only AI (visibility/cause/boundary uncertainty)

drift138.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.

drift139.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; authors retain rights. Local evaluation and limited attributed screenshots; no raw archive redistribution.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.

drift139.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.

drift138.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

drift139.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

dataset.license: Public research benchmark; authors retain rights. Local evaluation and limited attributed screenshots; no raw archive redistribution.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.

drift138.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

drift139.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

drift139.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

drift139.scope: Original-pixel algorithm replay checked before scoring. Warning usefulness uses independent target/visibility labels; false warnings and missed wrong proposals remain explicit. Confirmed recovery is internal appearance evidence; enclosing outcome audit determines correctness.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

input.provenance: Original VOT XYWH floats converted directly to clipped normalized corners, matching official parser (no MATLAB subtraction). NaN regions are not automatically treated as fully hidden: source-only AI review marks ambiguous/part-visible boundaries uncertain. No independent human adjudication of AI additions and no distractor boxes. All source images reviewed before predictions; labels never enter tracker.
